mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.5% in a single month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger a flight to quality, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.5% in a month, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and increase in the unemployment rate signals a monetary policy response to a weakening labor market, which typically precedes a 60-day period of positive S&P 500 returns as the market anticipates economic stabilization.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS decline >0.25pp and UNRATE rise >0.1pp in 3 months
failure_condition: The interaction signal fails when the S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances meeting the trigger condition, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion, a decline in housing starts below 1.3 million units signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in an impending slowdown.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion periods, S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST falls below 1.3 million, or the Rank IC for the regime-specific signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in consumer credit (RSAFS) over the past 3 months indicates rising consumer spending, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as the market reacts to stronger economic activity.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS increases for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 for two consecutive months, it signals a contraction in manufacturing output that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the market anticipates a recession.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO falls below 100 for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a federal funds rate above 5.0% signals aggressive policy that suppresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In monetary tightening cycles, S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0%, or the Rank IC for the regime-specific signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and rise in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a misalignment between consumer demand and manufacturing output, which typically precedes a 20-day period of positive S&P 500 returns as the market adjusts to the supply-demand imbalance.
candidate_trigger: HOUST decrease >0.5% and INDPRO increase >0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: The interaction signal fails when the S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances meeting the trigger condition, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.
